carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges are visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with a bright upper edge and a shadowed lower boundary.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent white, rectangular anthropogenic tag or attachment is visible on the upper dorsal surface, featuring a trailing translucent tether. A secondary thin, dark filament is visible trailing from the posterior edge of the left pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The left pectoral fin exhibits a high-density distribution of small-diameter high-luminance spots, significantly more concentrated than the pattern observed on the lateral flank.
